what.text: This page follows refugees from Eritrea living in Italy, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 2132 Eritrean refugees in Italy, 0.4% of all refugees from Eritrea.
Ethiopia and Sudan host the most Eritrean refugees, followed by Germany and Switzerland.

why.text: UCDP records interstate armed conflicts between Eritrea and Ethiopia from 1998 to 2000 and in 2016, and between Djibouti and Eritrea in 2008.
It also records armed conflict over the government of Eritrea in 1997, 1999 and 2003.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1980 at 142 refugees.
The figure was at its highest, 13357, at the end of 2014; the main years of displacement in the data are 2007 to 2019.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Italy.
These are year-end totals for Italy only, reported to UNHCR.
